{"metadata":{"description":"Firecrawl-backed web_search and web_fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web)","id":"gh:1336587180","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-firecrawl","slug":"firecrawl/dsh-firecrawl","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","firecrawl","web-scraping"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Firecrawl-backed web_search and web_fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ct"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"awl-backed web_search and web_fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Firecrawl for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"This plugin points DeepSeek Harness's built-in `web_search` **and** `web_fetch`

keeps asking for a query or a URL exactly as before, and Firecrawl "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"no new tools — the model
keeps asking for a query or a URL exactly as before, and Firecrawl answers."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"It supports `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` on Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
DeepSeek Harness is sti"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ll a developer preview, so later versions may need a
plugin update."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why fetch, and not just search"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The base Harness bundle ships `web_fetch` **disabled** and mounts no fetch
provider. The reason is i"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"n its own config comments: the only fetch backend is a
local HTTP client that "defers SSRF protectio"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"n and the model would choose the
request target." Turning it on points a model-chosen URL at whateve"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"r your
machine can reach, including your private network."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Firecrawl retrieves from its own infrastructure. The harness process never
opens the model-chosen co"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"nnection — it POSTs a URL to an API and gets markdown
back. That is a different risk decision from e"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"nabling the local provider, which
is why this plugin enables `web_fetch` where the base bundle does "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"not. You also
get JS rendering, anti-bot handling, and PDF parsing, none of which the local
provider"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ou also
get JS rendering, anti-bot handling, and PDF parsing, none of which the local
provider does."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Still worth knowing: **Firecrawl can reach any public URL the model asks for.**

choose. Leave `web_fetch` off if that is not ac"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ceptable for your deployment

- a model provider already configured in DeepSeek Har"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"m 10 or newer;
- a Firecrawl API key; and
- a model provider already configured in DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"You do not need to install `dsh` globally — the commands below run the
